interpretation: The healthy common sample contains economically positive static maker edges but no overlap with sufficient causal compatible contra-flow.
Seven of the eight capital-ranked baseline orders have zero compatible SELL prints in the causal lookback.

The only selected order with compatible SELL flow has a conservative queue-clearance proxy about 63x below the already relaxed 0.5% research fill-probability floor and recurrent fully sell-sided flow.
Lowering the 0.5 bp economic edge floor would not address this bottleneck and is not authorized by this evidence.
Generic inside-spread aggression is not supported by this sample; no candidate reached the improvement comparison after causal-flow admission.

next_bounded_experiment.hypothesis: Candidate construction should prioritize the intersection of positive post-cost edge with contemporaneous compatible contra-flow and queue-clearance capacity rather than static edge or nominal liquidity alone.
changes_allowed: instrument the admission funnel on fresh common samples
rank candidate sides by conservative fill-conditioned EV after the unchanged 0.5 bp economic floor
recycle dead-queue capital when compatible event-time flow becomes stale
permit quote improvement only when incremental fill-conditioned EV pays for the tick and adverse-selection penalty
changes_not_supported: lowering the 0.5 bp post-cost edge floor
increasing posted-order count as a success criterion
